newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Danish July c/a, trade surplus to fall.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Danish July c/a, trade surplus to fall.

text.p: Nine analysts polled by Reuters on Thursday predicted drops in Denmark's July current account and foreign trade surpluses.
Analysts expected an average July current account surplus of 0.4 billion crowns. Estimates ranged from minus 800 million to plus 1.5 billion crowns versus June's 1.2 billion crown surplus.
They saw an average foreign trade surplus of 1.9 billion crowns excluding ships. Estimates ranged from 1.4-3.2 billion crowns, compared to June's 2.7 billion crowns.
The data are due t 0730 GMT on Friday from the national statistics office.
